summary: News Corp filed an 8-K reporting routine daily ASX disclosures under its existing $1B stock repurchase program. The filing confirms ongoing buyback authority for Class A and Class B common stock, with no new material terms, prices, or timetable. The board previously authorized the program; no advisor or recommendation is mentioned. The disclosure is a regulatory formality under ASX rules. This is not a new or material special situation but a routine update on a standing capital return plan. The risk-arb angle is negligible; watch for execution pace and aggregate spend.
